cohort: 417 term and 169 preterm neonates born by Cesarean section
finding: Body temperature did not correlate with SpO2 or crSO2/cTOI, but there was a weak positive correlation with HR in all neonates and a weak correlation with prSO2 only in preterm infants.
mod_finding: This study found that preterm neonates born by Cesarean section had a statistically lower body temperature and suffered significantly more often from hypothermia during postnatal transition compared to term infants.
